entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: A prosperous empire spanning the continent of Ixalan, of four city-states, whose warriors cooperate with dinosaurs and are protected by sun priests.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane (and continent) on which the Sun Empire lies.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: A city-state of the Sun Empire and its capital before the invasion, besieged by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Atzocan
entities.description: A city-state of the Sun Empire near which the Phyrexian vanguard landed.

entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: One of the four major city-states of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A city-state from which the empire was founded, lost and retaken, and declared the new capital after the invasion.

entities.name: Chacanto Intli
entities.description: Founder of the Sun Empire, who united the city-states from Orazca.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli I
entities.description: A leader who fought a devastating war with the River Heralds using the Immortal Sun without restraint.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: The emperor who cemented the empire's grip on the land and was assassinated by Phyrexian sleeper agents.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli IV
entities.description: The young son of Apatzec III who succeeded him as emperor and who coined the term 'mechanoquetzacama'.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: A people who lived on Ixalan long before humans and once controlled the continent; they still confront the empire on its borders.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A source of power that the Sun Empire believes gave its priests the ability to command dinosaurs.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirates whose raids besieged the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: An invading force pushed back to the sea by the Sun Empire, later forced into an alliance against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The land of the Legion of Dusk's empire, target of a planned invasion by the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Dawn Fleet
entities.description: A fleet of hundreds of ships built to invade Torrezon, later planned anew with ten thousand ships.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Ixalan that overran the Sun Empire's cities and besieged Pachatupa.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who Phyrexianized Sun Empire citizens and dinosaurs and besieged the capital.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A commander whose mission to Orazca saved the empire from the Phyrexians and who later plans to depose Atlacan.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A formerly planeswalker artificer who, after her desparking, became a citizen of the Sun Empire and built mechanical dinosaurs.

entities.name: Atlacan Huicintli
entities.description: The emperor's steward, who plans to resume the war against Torrezon.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: A figure Huatli plans to place in power at the emperor's side.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: The sun aspect said to have formed the Sun Empire's people from clay.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: The original people of Ixalan's Core, from whom the Sun Empire's people descend.

events.summary: Chacanto Intli founds the Sun Empire from Orazca, uniting the city-states.
events.quote: The Sun Empire was first founded from Orazca by Chacanto Intli

events.summary: A devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I reduces the empire to a few coastal cities and costs it Orazca.
events.quote: Following a devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I

events.summary: The empire, besieged by Brazen Coalition raids and the Legion of Dusk, rises to fight off its enemies.
events.quote: The Sun Empire was besieged by pirate raids by the Brazen Coalition and the advance of the Legion of Dusk

events.summary: With Orazca retaken, the empire pushes the Legion of Dusk back to the sea and prepares an invasion of Torrezon.
events.quote: With Orazca retaken, the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

events.summary: Facing the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Sun Empire joins forces with the Legion of Dusk.
events.quote: the Sun Empire was forced to join forces with the Legion of Dusk to defend the plane.

events.summary: The Phyrexian vanguard lands near Atzocan and overwhelms the unprepared defenders.
events.quote: the Phyrexian vanguard landed near Atzocan, surprising the Sun Empire and overwhelming the unprepared defenders.

events.summary: Phyrexian forces sweep the outer cities and besiege the capital Pachatupa.
events.quote: encircling the capital and committing it to siege

events.summary: Huatli and her commandos undertake a desperate mission to Orazca to call the elder dinosaurs and break the siege, saving the empire and Ixalan.
events.quote: A desperate mission to Orazca by Huatli and her commandos, to call the elder dinosaurs to Orazca and break the siege of Pachatupa

events.summary: Emperor Apatzec Intli III is assassinated by Phyrexian sleeper agents and succeeded by his young son.
events.quote: Emperor Apatzec Intli III was assassinated by Phyrexian sleeper agents

events.summary: After the invasion Orazca is revived and declared the new capital and refuge for the displaced.
events.quote: Orazca was revived and declared the new capital

events.summary: Saheeli Rai, desparked, becomes a citizen of the Sun Empire and enters court politics with her dinosaur automatons.
events.quote: Saheeli Rai became a citizen of the Sun Empire

events.summary: Atlacan plans to resume the war against Torrezon; Huatli plans to depose him.

relations.note: Founded the empire by uniting the city-states.
relations.quote: The Sun Empire was first founded from Orazca by Chacanto Intli

relations.note: A devastating war and continued confrontation on the borders.
relations.quote: The empire still confronted the Heralds on its borders.

relations.note: The empire fights the New Phyrexian Invasion.
relations.quote: the Phyrexian vanguard landed near Atzocan, surprising the Sun Empire and overwhelming the unprepared defenders.

relations.note: Forced to join forces against the invasion.
relations.quote: the Sun Empire was forced to join forces with the Legion of Dusk to defend the plane.
succeeded by his young son Apatzec Intli IV
Emperor Apatzec Intli III was assassinated by Phyrexian sleeper agents
